diagnosis: In version v2, get_queryset() allows filtering by an arbitrary user_id query parameter without ensuring target_user matches request.user.id. Any user can view and manage API keys belonging to other users by passing their user_id in v2 requests.

Host: api.developerplatform.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
corrected_code:
from rest_framework import viewsets, permissions
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from rest_framework.versioning import URLPathVersioning
from .models import UserApiKey
from .serializers import ApiKeySerializer

class UserApiKeyViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    serializer_class = ApiKeySerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    versioning_class = URLPathVersioning

    def get_queryset(self):
        target_user = self.request.query_params.get("user_id")
        if target_user and int(target_user) != self.request.user.id and not self.request.user.is_staff:
            raise PermissionDenied("Cannot query API keys of other users")
        return UserApiKey.objects.filter(user=self.request.user)
